diagnostics.text: Available records list 1,556 data-center sites in development, equal to 0.51 times the 3,068 operating sites; 894 sites are in the tracked active pipeline. diagnostics.message: Conspicuous same-initial word run detected: CoreWeave captures contrast CNBC
diagnostics.text: AI-linked equities have strengthened materially, but the financing picture is less uniform. The AI Equity Index reached 37.9, the median one-year return rose to 11.0%, and 64.2% of covered companies now show positive one-year returns. At the same time, borrower strain increased to 30.2 even though operating cash flow still covers current capital spending by 1.23 times. CoreWeave captures the contrast: CNBC reported that it beat on revenue and raised guidance, while a separate report put its bond yield above 16%. Stronger operating news and broad equity gains coexist with a very high bond yield for at least one AI-linked borrower.
